skill.name: Growth Strategy
skill.description: Design ethical growth strategies using product-led loops, measurable experiments, and privacy-aware guardrails.
skill.summary: Create disciplined growth plans that improve activation, retention, referrals, and measurement.
skill.author: ClementWalter

content.value_statement: Growth work can drift toward vanity metrics, unreliable attribution, and tactics that harm user trust. This skill turns product goals into measurable growth loops, controlled experiments, and privacy-aware guardrails.
actual_capabilities: Frames initiatives around a north star metric and leading input metrics.
Designs growth loops for viral, content, paid, and sales-led acquisition.
Creates experiment plans with hypotheses, segments, success metrics, guardrails, and kill criteria.
Suggests improvements for activation, onboarding, retention, referrals, and lifecycle messaging.
Recommends measurement approaches such as cohorts, holdouts, and incrementality testing.
Screens proposed tactics against privacy, deliverability, platform policy, and ethical constraints.
limitations: It does not access analytics platforms or validate live business data.
It cannot guarantee experiment results or forecast precise growth outcomes.
It does not replace legal, privacy, deliverability, or platform-policy review.
Recommendations require product context, implementation resources, and human judgment.

use_cases.title: Plan a SaaS activation experiment
use_cases.description: Define an onboarding test that reduces time-to-value while protecting retention and support metrics.

use_cases.title: Improve referral growth responsibly
use_cases.description: Design a referral loop that rewards activated users and avoids spam or deceptive incentives.

use_cases.title: Review a measurement plan
use_cases.description: Assess attribution assumptions and add cohort, holdout, or incrementality methods where needed.

prompt_templates.title: Find a growth focus
prompt_templates.prompt: Our product is [product] for [audience]. Our goal is [goal]. Suggest one north star metric, three input metrics, and the first growth lever to investigate.

prompt_templates.title: Design an onboarding test
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an experiment for [product] onboarding. Include the hypothesis, target segment, success metric, guardrails, sample-size approach, implementation steps, and kill criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Build a referral loop
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an ethical referral loop for [product and audience]. Explain the user value, sharing trigger, reward rule, activation definition, abuse safeguards, and measurements.

prompt_templates.title: Prioritize a growth portfolio
prompt_templates.prompt: Given these opportunities: [list], score them with RICE or ICE. Recommend a four-week experiment portfolio with owners, dependencies, metrics, guardrails, and stop conditions.

output_examples.input: Create an activation experiment for a team collaboration product.
output: Initiative: shorten the path to the first shared workspace.
Hypothesis: guided teammate invitations will increase activated accounts.
Guardrails: invitation complaints, churn, and support contacts must not rise.
Kill the test if activation does not improve after the agreed sample size.

output_examples.input: Review a proposed email reactivation campaign.
output: Use consented segments and define an inactivity threshold.
Measure reactivation, unsubscribe rate, complaints, and long-term retention.
Stop or revise the campaign if deliverability guardrails decline.

best_practices: Start with a clear business goal, north star metric, and leading input metrics.
Define guardrails and kill criteria before launching an experiment.
Use first-party data and test incrementality when attribution is uncertain.
anti_patterns: Do not optimize vanity metrics without checking retention, quality, and user value.
Do not send unsolicited messages, use fake reviews, or use deceptive incentives.
Do not scale AI-generated content without quality review and a clear user benefit.

faq.question: What types of growth work does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports strategy, experiments, onboarding, activation, retention, referrals, content, and lifecycle planning.

faq.question: Can it create an A/B test plan?
faq.answer: Yes. It can structure a hypothesis, audience, metrics, guardrails, sample-size rule, and kill criteria.

faq.question: Does it recommend unethical growth tactics?
faq.answer: No. The guidance explicitly rejects spam, fake reviews, prohibited scraping, dark patterns, and deceptive consent.

faq.question: Can it analyze my live analytics?
faq.answer: No. Provide your metrics and context in the prompt for interpretation and planning.

faq.question: How does it address privacy?
faq.answer: It favors first-party data, resilient measurement, and tactics that respect user privacy and platform policies.

faq.question: Is this a replacement for compliance review?
faq.answer: No. Consult qualified legal, privacy, and deliverability professionals for applicable requirements.
